description: Integrate Laya into eligible ordinary Local AI Hub context decisions using existing bounded Hub services. Collect only genuine runtime outcomes scoped to repository/task/session. No consent, per-example receipt, or separate approval is a prerequisite for runtime capture, candidate storage, review, labeling, or export. Inputs contain typed gap/source/freshness/coverage codes and verified evidence IDs; deterministic retrieval remains authoritative. Review and human-label samples after practical use. This installation has a cached pinned checkpoint with verified file hashes and runtime enabled, CPU fallback disabled. Do not generate cards, train, benchmark, install runtime/drivers, or download model weights in this task.

acceptance_criteria: Category meets the approved quality gate with no necessary-fact loss and one fewer retrieval roundtrip.
Two independent annotators and adjudicator validate reference labels.
No insufficient-data result or unresolved provenance blocker.
Advisory remains opt-in and cannot trigger tools, task transitions, permissions, routing, or global automation.
Promotion to advisory requires separate explicit user approval.
task_laya_advisory.blocker: No practical candidate category has passed paired quality evaluation.
task_laya_advisory.description: Expose typed advisory through an existing API/tool only after context_source passes paired evaluation against deterministic retrieval and explicit later approval. Caller cannot set mode, identity, permissions, or global automation. Result remains a proposal; errors/abstention explicit.
task_laya_advisory.next_action: Keep unregistered until natural examples are reviewed and the category passes evaluation.
task_laya_advisory.title: Expose explicit typed advisory call after validation

acceptance_criteria: Human review rejects unsuitable or duplicate examples and labels useful cases with a versioned rubric.
Unresolved, rejected, and test-split examples stay out of training exports.
Group provenance prevents related sessions from leaking across splits.
Training and benchmark remain unstarted until the user requests them after collection and review.
Future comparison uses the same held-out examples and records quality, latency, and compute separately.
task_laya_evaluation.blocker: Requires genuine examples from ordinary Hub use and human-reviewed labels.
task_laya_evaluation.description: After a practical collection period, review naturally captured candidates, reject unsuitable examples, obtain two independent annotations plus adjudication, and prepare paired before/after evaluation. Human labels require versioned rubric and reviewer provenance; per-example consent receipts are not required.
task_laya_evaluation.next_action: Wait for natural samples; review and label before any training or benchmark request.
task_laya_evaluation.title: Build paired fixtures and evaluate quality, cost, and latency

acceptance_criteria: Eligible trigger remains successful ordinary context retrieval, unresolved evidence gap and at least two authorized verified sources.
Typed Laya input contains trusted gap/source/freshness/coverage codes and verified evidence IDs only; excludes task/source text.
Only actual runtime outcomes become candidates; capture lifecycle emits status and typed skip/failure reason through existing telemetry without request content.
Candidate storage uses canonical repository/task/session scope; no per-example consent receipt or parallel database.
This installation config enables the pinned cached checkpoint with expected SHA-256 files; CPU fallback remains disabled.
Laya output remains shadow-only and never changes retrieval, routing, permissions, task state, receipts, or tool execution.
No model download, runtime/driver install, cloud inference, training, benchmark, advisory activation, or card generation.
task_laya_evidence.blocker: Pre-fix live telemetry showed 126 successful /api/context/pack requests, 0 Laya decisions, 0 candidates, and no Laya errors. Source-level capture/telemetry fixes and targeted tests pass; runtime activation and one natural eligible capture remain unverified.
task_laya_evidence.description: Verify ordinary Local AI Hub Laya context_source capture on this installation. Persist only genuine runtime outcomes and metadata-only capture lifecycle stage/reason through existing storage; preserve repository/task/session identity, typed evidence codes and verified evidence IDs. No request/source text or per-example consent receipts.
task_laya_evidence.next_action: Activate the fixed source in the running Hub without interrupting active work; inspect metadata-only capture stages and candidate rows after the next natural eligible ordinary request.
task_laya_evidence.title: Inspect Hub decision surfaces and verify model provenance

acceptance_criteria: Ordinary ZIP and diagnostics exclude candidate text.

Training export needs explicit dataset selection, valid scoped runtime provenance, reviewed and verified human label provenance, and authorized repository/task/session scope; no per-example consent receipt.
Manifest counts included, skipped, rejected, ambiguous, and missing records without reconstructing absent data.
Group-safe split and duplicate checks stay enforced.
task_laya_export.blocker: No practical runtime examples exist yet; wait for ordinary eligible Hub use.
task_laya_export.description: Maintain scoped candidate export from naturally collected Laya runtime outcomes. Per-example consent receipts are not required. Keep ordinary diagnostics metadata-only; training export includes only current, human-reviewed and independently verified labels with group-safe provenance.
task_laya_export.next_action: After natural capture, review snapshot/export behavior; do not export training data now.
task_laya_export.title: Extend existing reports and authorized ZIP

acceptance_criteria: Use existing Hub service/executor, state directory, cache, and candidate store; no parallel service/database.
Keep lifecycle safe across timeout, inflight requests, reload, provider-close errors, and shutdown.
Use only installed verified adapters; unknown device capabilities remain unknown.
Explicit hardware policy and quality gates remain authoritative; do not claim unverified device placement or memory release.
No model pulls, runtime/driver install, training, benchmark, or rollout in this task.
task_laya_foundation.blocker: Actual runtime adapter execution and natural capture await eligible ordinary Hub requests.
task_laya_foundation.description: Use existing Hub service/executor, state directory, cache, and candidate store; no parallel service/database. This installation has Laya shadow inference enabled with a cached pinned checkpoint whose configured hashes were verified. Keep CPU fallback disabled. No daemon/runtime/driver installation, model pulls, training, benchmark, or rollout.
task_laya_foundation.next_action: Keep inference lazy and observe natural capture evidence; no synthetic smoke inference.
task_laya_foundation.title: Implement only independently useful contract infrastructure

acceptance_criteria: The active Laya plan/specification reflect corrected operator scope and remove superseded narrow exclusions.
One typed Laya decision service is callable through MCP and root-authorized HTTP with server-bound identity/mode and evidence validation.
Relevant decision points have deterministic baselines and proposals; only categories with measured benefit become opt-in advisory.
Useful actual examples collect minimum raw input when needed, baseline and Laya outputs, downstream outcomes, labels, provenance, runtime metrics, and failures.
Capture stays local, scoped, redacted, revalidatable, deletable; verified labels and group-safe exports keep validation/test out of training.
MCP/API, category gates, privacy, lifecycle, failure isolation, and datasets have current evidence; live model/provider claims remain separate.

clarifications.summary: Operator clarified prior plan underscoped Laya. Expand beyond context_source metadata shadow: expose typed decisions through MCP and HTTP, integrate decision points where measured gains support reliability/quality/speed/useful behavior, and collect future-training examples including raw content when materially useful. Exclude secrets and unrelated private material; keep capture local, scoped, deletable, provenance-rich, and group-safe. Collect now; fine-tuning remains deferred.

task_laya_shadow.description: Implement the operator-corrected Laya scope: expose a shared typed decision service through MCP and root-authorized HTTP API; integrate decision categories across Hub only where measurements show improved reliability, quality, speed, or useful behavior; collect all useful future-training evidence including minimum necessary raw content, baseline and Laya outputs, downstream outcomes, labels, provenance, runtime metadata and failures. Keep data local, scoped, redacted, revalidatable and deletable; preserve deterministic authority and group-safe train/eval/test separation.
task_laya_shadow.next_action: Map supported MCP/API dispatch, decision baselines, and training capture before implementation.
task_laya_shadow.title: Rozšířit Laya: MCP/API, relevantní rozhodovací body a tréninková data
